story: A 7-day landing at Connecting Ridge on 2027-02-08 meets every default requirement. If the launch slips 5 days, the lander arrives on 2027-02-13, when the Sun sets for 63 h in a row. That is longer than the 50 h the battery is declared to survive, so the plan fails. Mission Rescue then finds passing options, for example a landing at Malapert Massif about 3 days after the delayed date.
